text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also brings serious ethical challenges. One major concern is bias: AI systems trained on historical data can reflect or even magnify existing prejudices, leading to unfair outcomes in hiring, lending, or criminal justice. Fairness means actively checking these systems and correcting imbalances so that everyone is treated equally. Privacy is equally important. AI often relies on vast amounts of personal data, so companies must protect this information and use it responsibly. Transparency is another key principle—users should understand how decisions are made by an AI. Finally, responsible AI development requires collaboration among engineers, policymakers, and the public to set clear guidelines and ensure these powerful tools benefit society without causing harm.
